common.errorBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell your manager.
common.notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or your role cannot open it.

auth.signInIntro: Use the email and password your manager gave you.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email or password is not right. Check them and try again.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait one minute, then try again.
auth.genericError: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.twoFactorIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Yanmu Nursery.
auth.invalidCode: That code did not work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.

mfa.setupIntro: Your role can see money and personal data, so signing in needs your password and a code from your phone.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfa.step2: Confirm your password to create your personal code.
mfa.step3: Scan the square code with the app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: Square code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
mfa.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Write them down and keep them somewhere safe.

sections.home: Your daily picture: money, children, team and what needs your decision.
sections.branches: Compare the branches side by side.
sections.inbox: Approvals, critical incidents and follow-ups waiting for you.
sections.issues: Maintenance, equipment and supply issues with due dates.
sections.today: Today's attendance, team, payments and the daily close.
sections.add: Record a payment, expense, incident, issue, child or roll call.
sections.invoices: Monthly invoices, late fees and credit notes.
sections.month-close: Close the month with your Excel template.
sections.payment: Record a payment and print a receipt.
sections.cash-box: Open the cash box, count it and hand it over.
sections.my-room: The children in your room today.
sections.roll-call: Mark who is here, one tap per child.
sections.incident: Log an incident in four quick fields.
